story: An icon of the skies, the Ural Owl (Strix uralensis) is a species from the Strigidae family. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Ural Owl is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Ural Owl helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife.
